channel.title: Geckoboard incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Geckoboard's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Investigating issues with dashbords displaying blank [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting some dashboards from not displaying correctly has now been resolved. Thank you for your patience. Please contact us at support@geckoboard.com if you experience any further issues.

item.title: Issues with Dropbox widgets not loading [resolved]
item.description: The issue affecting Dropbox accounts has been resolved, and widgets are loading normally. If you continue to have any issues, please reach out to our team at support@geckoboard.com, and we'll help further.

item.title: Partial outage affecting subscription management and billing portal [resolved]
item.description: Our payment provider has resolved the outage affecting billing and the subscription management API. If you are experiencing any issues with your subscription, please contact our team directly at support@geckoboard.com for further assistance.

item.title: Disruption affecting Campaign Monitor [resolved]
item.description: The Campaign Monitor issue has been resolved by their team.

item.title: Login issues affecting SSO users [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting SSO sign-in has been resolved. The upstream provider deployed a fix and confirmed recovery, and SSO logins are working normally again (https://status.workos.com/)
All other platform functionality remained unaffected throughout. If you're still having trouble signing in, please reach out to support@geckoboard.com.

item.title: Some legacy dashboards unavailable [resolved]
item.description:
The issue affecting legacy dashboards has now been resolved.
Thank you for your patience while we worked on a fix. If you continue to experience any issues, please contact us at support@geckoboard.com.

item.title: Adding and Editing widgets failing to load the selection screen for some dashboards [resolved]
item.description: A fix has been implemented for the issue preventing some users from adding or editing dashboard widgets, and widgets can now be added and edited normally. If you continue to experience any unexpected behavior, please reach out to our team at support@geckoboard.com for further assistance.

item.title: Investigating issues with Spreadsheets data sources [resolved]
item.description: Service incident related to Spreadsheets is now resolved. Thank you for your patience. Please contact us at support@geckoboard.com if you experience any further issues.

item.title: Investigating issues with Shopify [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting Shopify connections has been resolved. Please reach out to support@geckoboard.com if you are experiencing any further issues.

item.title: Issues with widgets not refreshing [resolved]
item.description: Service incident related to widgets not refreshing is now resolved. Please contact us at support@geckoboard.com if you experience any further issues.

item.title: Investigating issues with Klaviyo [resolved]
item.description: Service incident related to the Klaviyo integration is now resolved. Please contact us at support@geckoboard.com if you experience any further issues.

item.title: Identified issues affecting HubSpot, Aircall and Pipedrive refresh times [resolved]
item.description: Service incident affecting HubSpot, Aircall and Pipedrive refresh times is now resolved. Please contact us at support@geckoboard.com if you experience any further issues.

item.title: Intermittent dashboard/login issues [resolved]
item.description: We've successfully resolved the underlying issue. Thank you for your patience.

item.title: MS Teams Snapshots and Notifications [resolved]
item.description: The issue impacting MS Teams has been resolved. New connections and snapshots are working again as expected. Please reach out to our team at support@geckoboard.com if you have any further trouble with your MS Teams connections.

item.title: Investigating issues with Slack connections [resolved]
item.description: The incident involving Slack connections has now been resolved. Thank you for your patience. Please contact us at support@geckoboard.com if you need any further assistance.

Thank you for your patience. Please contact us at support@geckoboard.com if you experience any further issues or have questions.
